title: Harrow: Surge of Power on Healing Needles vs Leech Therapy
question: Where does Surge of Power's 14s proc and +28 spirit do more?
hypothesis: Needles have no cooldown and recharge every ~11-16s in fights (bullet hits 1.26%/hit, leeches 0.15%/s each), so Surge procs ~every 14s (57% speed uptime) and adds +16.8 heal per needle at T3; Leech (20s, 16s with Superior Cooldown) procs at most 40-50% and adds +13.7 DPS. Prediction: heal delivered per 60s >=10% higher on Needles arm.
controls: Cooldowns, HP, leech stacks reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the item/imbue under test
Same enemy hero, level, items, behaviour
procedure: 60s: shoot enemy to charge, needle the ally whenever a charge is ready, Leech on cooldown
Record Surge procs, heal delivered, damage dealt

decision.rule: SUPPORTS surge_needles if >=10% higher with non-overlapping ranges
